changelogEn: New background image — glowing blue music notes
All buttons and options now in 3D glass style
New Duet voice option — Male / Female / Duet — for songs sung by male and female voices together
Colors now match the Suno app exactly — black, white and grey everywhere
Connects automatically — no setup, no cookie, no settings: just open the app and make songs
Interface redesigned to match the Suno app's look and feel — Create, Library and Player, same-to-same
Settings screen removed — only Create, Reference and Library
